item.title: 🆕 ADDED Azure role
item.description:
Id: 506c2fa4-2713-45d3-a893-4b1360a66e88
Display name: Discovery Log Analytics Cluster Linker - Preview
Description: Allows the Discovery control plane to link Log Analytics workspaces to a customer's dedicated cluster for CMK (customer-managed key) encryption. Grants only cluster read and write permissions — no storage key access, no VM extensions, no broad read.
